narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Each gets fourteen metres and one left over. We cannot share the last metre any more.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But a metre of ribbon can still be cut into smaller pieces.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Cut it in the middle, and each girl gets half a metre.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Share out the whole metres first, one metre to each person at a time.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then write the leftover share as tenths, and add it on.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Seven metres of rope is shared equally by two friends. How much does each get?
